WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 25 in Block 1259 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 15 West 43rd Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; Rights (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 29 in Block 1259 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 7 West 43d Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B-1” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land is herein referred to as the “Intervening Parcel"), and in connection therewith, Developer simultaneously herewith will combine the Intervening Parcel and the Developer Parcel into a single zoning lot (the “Existing Merged Zoning Lot") by declaration of zoning lot restrictions dated as of the date hereof and to be recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York,NewYork County;
